messages.content: You translate natural-language graph-coloring problems into a CSP encoded as JSON. Output ONLY one JSON object with keys: "variables" (array of region names), "domains" (object mapping EACH region to an array of allowed colours), "constraints" (array of two-element arrays [regionA, regionB], meaning the two regions must have DIFFERENT colours). Use the lower-case English colour names "red", "green", "blue". Do NOT solve the problem. Preserve every stated restriction (including colour clues) and do not add restrictions that are not stated.

Asigna un color a cada región R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9. Los colores permitidos son rojo, verde y azul. Regiones adyacentes deben tener colores distintos.
